title: feat(motion): engrave and trace open and closed sketch chains
body:
Engrave and Trace now follow open and closed chains from a placed sketch. The user can select a profile, individual chains or a layer. The operation preserves the cut direction of lines, arcs and circles. It applies the sketch placement and the work-coordinate rotation to both endpoints and arc centers. A lift separates disconnected strokes and gaps accepted by the drawing tolerance.

Each depth level approaches from the stock surface. The existing stock, fixture, shank and mark-depth checks can hold the post, including jobs that have no part solid. Very short arcs below the post resolution give a diagnostic. A major arc is split into two arcs that keep its center and sweep. #3442 tracks the separate case where a native Fanuc post accepts a short arc supplied directly in an intermediate file.

The 18-move CL fixture contains an open line and clockwise quarter arc, a closed semicircle and diameter, and a full circle in two arcs. It records the tool rising to clearance between the three strokes.

## Goldens moved

No existing golden moves. One new recorded file is added.

- `crates/app/tests/golden/sketch_engrave_trace.cl` (NEW, not moved)

The new CL file records 18 moves. It contains an open line and clockwise quarter arc, a closed semicircle and diameter, and a full circle in two arcs. It records the tool rising to clearance between the three strokes. The test `placed_sketch_marks_keep_open_and_closed_arcs_and_retract_between_strokes` compares the generated moves with this file.

## Verification

- On the parent source, `placed_sketch_marks_keep_open_and_closed_arcs_and_retract_between_strokes` failed because an operation could not use picked sketch chains. The same test passed on this fix. The original CLI also refused both Engrave and Trace on a whole profile.
- On `2032dda7e`, all 11 feature tests passed. The 18 moves matched the checked-in golden. The stock depth, underside, stock rapid, crossing and fixture checks held the post when required. Project round-trip and MCP passed.
- `short_and_near_full_arcs_keep_their_center_and_sweep_through_a_rotated_work_offset` checks the arc centers and sweeps. The native CLI generated, verified and posted six synthetic drawings across both operations. Short representable arcs kept distinct endpoints. The 270-degree and near-full sweeps used split arcs with the correct centers. Both sub-resolution cases gave a named refusal and wrote no NC file.
- The focused gate passed 480 app tests, 127 post tests, and 29 motion tests on the final commit. Strict Clippy passed for all app, motion, and post targets with warnings denied. A broader motion run passed 646 tests with 10 ignored on the earlier branch revision with identical motion source.
- The broad quick plan was a dry run. The focused app, motion and post suites and strict Clippy ran on this head. All 243 selected release-mode execution steps completed. They recorded 105 passing ignored tests and 4 registered expected failures. Of the selected steps, 206 had no ignored cases to run. Each selected suite compiled on demand. The separate aggregate compile-only step was omitted.

The CLI checks used synthetic drawings and the native post. No physical machine ran the resulting programs.

## Review gates on head c7048825c (after the second merge of main)

- Merge base: `origin/main` `3c68dcaf2`. Merge commit: `173abf61b`.
- Hand-resolved hunk: `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`, the Trace and Engrave arm.
  - Main (#3349) split the Engrave arm to plan with `machining2d::trace_avoid` when a "Do not touch" spec is set.
  - This PR joins the Trace and Engrave arms and adds the sketch-stroke path.
  - The resolution keeps both. A sketch pick rides its strokes (`strokes.trace`). A model pick runs `trace_avoid` for Engrave with a spec, and the plain `trace` for Trace, as on main.
- New commit `c7048825c` `fix(app): judge sketch Engrave strokes against Do not touch`:
  - `trace_avoid` takes closed loops only, so it cannot plan around open sketch strokes.
  - The final path of a sketch Engrave now goes through `avoid::protect_path`, as a Trace does. Links are lifted, and a stroke that meets a protected item is refused by name.
  - A sketch Trace already went through `protect_path` on main. The post gate (`live_avoid_problems`) applies to both.
- Pinning test: `sketch_engrave_trace::avoid::do_not_touch_refuses_a_sketch_stroke_that_passes_too_near_a_protected_face` (Trace and Engrave). A mutation that removes the sketch Engrave judgement makes it fail.
- Targeted runs: `sketch_engrave_trace` 12 passed; `do_not_touch` 7 passed (main's Trace avoidance tests); `do_not_touch_engrave` 3 passed.
- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 855 steps, 1 failed, 0 stalled. 8,112 tests passed, 1 failed, 135 ignored.
  - The red step is `app suites: rotary_verify`, `a_rough_over_an_oversized_bar_peels_from_the_stock_radius` (2,110 moves, pinned 2,064). Main was red there at the merge base (#3774). Main fixed it in `473600714` after the merge. This PR does not touch the rotary code or the test.
- `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`: in the quick plan, 41 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Delta class (`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 3458 --reviewed e42e54249`): NEW CODE. `173abf61` is a merge of main, HAND-RESOLVED in `generate.rs`; `c7048825` is a new commit.
